tools.name: egm_readiness
tools.description: Read-only offline readiness report for the Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) installed natively by `bun run egm:install`: one command writes the pinned EGM v0.1.1 release (31 sha256-pinned upstream files at commit dea7761de06c) under the GJC agent directory, composes the 7 `/skill:egm-*` skills with 3 references, registers 8 read-only reviewers (`tools: read, search, find`) and records ownership in bundle.json. Reports the ownership journal, a sha256 comparison of every bundle and loose file, extra egm-* agents, the session settings that can disable the task subagent or a reviewer, `task`-tool visibility, and remediation. Never installs, fetches or runs EGM, writes nothing and never contacts the network.
